scope_limit: Own renderer and small models. Not a published benchmark. No claim about large models or real robots.

fixed_choices.encoder: Shared frozen EMA encoder per seed and family, so latent and nolatent losses share units.
fixed_choices.cost: Models pay env.cost on the probe's decoding; the oracle pays it on true observations. Same goal, same success test.
fixed_choices.burn_in: stack - 1 zero-action steps in the true simulator before every trajectory and episode, oracle included.
fixed_choices.ladder: Smallest rung passing Gate GP on val_in of the pilot seed. Thresholds are never changed.
fixed_choices.hybrid: hybrid and hybrid_eb use latent_opt's validated lr_scale. hybrid's lambda is validated, hybrid_eb's is evidence-chosen.
fixed_choices.h14_closed_loop: The error-fed belief stays where adaptation left it, as a latent does, so it gets the same data as other methods.
fixed_choices.h4_lambda: H4p uses the better RLS and its h10-selected lambda, as thread_b's rollout rule.

H17.note: Three seeds: means only, no verdict.
